_comment: BUILD CONFIGURATION MAP (node-by-node). An importable v2 template is ALSO generated at templates/12-Part 3-template.json (via tools/gen_template.py), grounded in the public shashankcube/computer-skill v2 examples. That template is an IMPORT DRAFT: live import/run is UNVERIFIED (never claim it was imported). After import you MUST (1) select an active sandbox Bearer Auth Token CONNECTION on the HTTP node, (2) set the safety guard constants in the two Execute Code nodes (ALLOW_LIVE_CREATE / EXPECTED_PART_ID / EXPECTED_TEST_OWNER_ID in build_request; ALLOW_OWNER_NOTIFICATION / EXPECTED_TEST_OWNER_ID in notify_policy), and (3) filter the trigger to the dedicated Part 3 test part AND severity == 'low'. edison-org-for-test ONLY. The Execute Code bodies are in code/ (build_request.py, validate_response.py, reverse_severity.py, notify_policy.py) and are covered by tests/part3/test_part3.py; the template embeds grounded copies of those bodies PLUS default-safe preflight/notify guards. The works.create response field path for work.id/display_id is NOT verified - confirm it against a REAL sandbox capture.
title: DevRevU Part 3 - HTTP works.create + reverse severity

trigger.filter: REQUIRED: dedicated Part 3 test part AND severity == 'low'

nodes.notes: Builds the works.create JSON via json.dumps. owned_by must be an ARRAY of user DONs - map the trigger owned_by objects to their .id.

nodes.import_shape_known: serialization grounded in public v2 example (working-csat http_1); LIVE import/run still UNVERIFIED
nodes.auth: Use an ACTIVE sandbox Auth Token CONNECTION (Bearer). NEVER paste a raw token into the node or this repo.
nodes.idempotency: Body carries external_ref 'devrevu-p3:<ticket id>' to MITIGATE duplicates (not exactly-once). Prefer: check for an existing work with that external_ref BEFORE create, or handle a 409 conflict explicitly. Do NOT blindly POST-retry.
nodes.response_capture: Capture status_code and the full JSON body in the node outputs. Configure the DOWNSTREAM output mapping from an ACTUAL captured sandbox response - the real works.create response field path for work.id/display_id MUST be verified in the sandbox (no committed sample).

nodes.notes: RAISES on non-2xx OR missing work.id/display_id so a non-2xx HTTP finish becomes a FAILED run. Never leaks body/token. Verify the real response field path and set outputs from the actual response.
Comment goes on the CREATED ISSUE (work_id from validate_response).

nodes.note: Screenshot deliverable asks for comments on BOTH ticket and issue, so also post an internal comment on the originating ticket.

body.value: Linked issue {% expr $get('validate_response','output').display_id %} created for this ticket.

nodes.notes: Optional supported enhancement: link the Ticket to the created Issue if a link operation is available in your org.

nodes.import_shape_known: serialization grounded in public v2 examples (working-loop send_notification_1 + working-csat if_else_1); LIVE import/run still UNVERIFIED
nodes.message: {% expr $get('notify_policy_1','output').notification %} (resolves to '<ISS display_id> has been created for your ticket.')
nodes.default_safe_gate: In the generated template, notify_policy_1 outputs should_notify=False by default; a native if_else (notify_gate_1) only routes to send_notification on the TRUE branch (should_notify == true). The FALSE branch ends safely with NO notification. Enable by setting ALLOW_OWNER_NOTIFICATION=True AND EXPECTED_TEST_OWNER_ID to your own user DON in the notify_policy node.
nodes.notes: notify_policy.py enforces 'notify only after a verified create' and produces the exact message/comment bodies. If your org's send_notification/if_else import differs, configure in UI as the remaining gap.
